body:
Hi Leonard,

The bridge-round send list is done. It's "Q4 update - send list" in my Q4 2025 investor update folder, and I've shared it with you as an editor. It's current as of end of day Tue Sep 30 (Pacific) and has one row per firm or angel, with group, amount and build access.

Counts by group:
- New investor: 0 firms, 1 angel. Anton Bernstein, $25K. His DocuSign Completed notice came in Sep 26 for the re-issued $25K SAFE.
- In talks: 7 firms, 1 angel.
  - Firms: GFR Fund, a16z, Dentsu Ventures, T-Accelerate, NCsoft, Homa and Brightwater Games Fund. Homa and Brightwater aren't on the 2025 list but had calls on my calendar.
  - Angel: Paul Heydon at $50K. His SAFE was still unsigned in DocuSign, so he isn't a new investor yet.
- Awaiting reply: 14 firms, 0 angels.
- Keep warm: 3 firms, 0 angels. LVP, Hiro Capital and SciPlay. SciPlay passed to Robert by phone on Sep 30. All three are now on a "Keep warm" checklist on the Existing Investor Update card.

Things to look at on Monday:
- a16z is under "in talks". Their Sep 30 letter was the speedrun decision, and per your doc that isn't their answer on the bridge.
- Build access: T-Accelerate and Dentsu have iOS only. Arthur found that the Play investor tester list was never attached to the internal track. ZOM-567 shows them as added, but neither has Android yet. He plans to attach it with today's build, so we may want to update those two rows before the update goes out. No other firm in talks has the internal build yet.
- Kevin Lin, Mike Fischer and Demetri Detsaridis are off the list. I couldn't find any contact with them since Sep 3.

Talk Monday,
Fred
